scientific_integrity: Analytical proof of the infinite joint limit; exact-rational and high-precision checks are corroborative only. No independently validated status is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only the invariant one-dimensional edge and the specified joint parameter/horizon limit are proved; downstream offset is fixed. The same work later appeared in a 2021 journal rendering whose full text was not accessible. Publication priority remains evidence-limited.
title: A moving-time critical crossover on the five-phase quadratic edge cycle
